PARAMS = {
    "N":     (5.0, 2.0, 20.0),       # pass : gate-diode mirror ratio
    "K":     (100.0, 20.0, 500.0),   # pass : adaptive-tail ratio
    "gmid_p":(6.0, 4.0, 12.0),       # pass gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX
    "Lp":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # pass / diode / adaptive L
    "It":    (10e-6, 4e-6, 20e-6),   # EA static tail current
    "Lea":   (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),        # EA input pair L
    "Lld":   (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),        # EA NMOS mirror-load L
    "gmid_cs":(15.0, 8.0, 22.0),     # CS transconductor gm/Id at light load
    "Rdiv":  (600e3, 150e3, 2e6),    # each divider resistor (R1=R2 -> 2x)
    "Cff":   (50e-15, 1e-15, 1e-12), # feed-forward cap across R1
}

def _vgs_for(lu, dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
    lo, hi = 0.0, 1.8
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lu.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = 1.8
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6)
    vt = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3)
    imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    beta = vref / vt

    N, K = p["N"], p["K"]
    It = p["It"]
    Ib = It / 4.0
    Rdiv = p["Rdiv"]
    R1 = Rdiv
    R2 = Rdiv * vref / (vt - vref)
    idiv = vt / (R1 + R2)
    Ipl, Iph = imin + idiv, imax + idiv

    # ---- pass device (sized at max load), gate diode and adaptive device are scaled copies
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Iph, vds=0.6)
    Wp, Lp = mp.W, p["Lp"]
    Wd = max(0.42, Wp / N)
    Wa = max(0.42, Wp / K)

    # ---- bias chain: IREF -> NMOS diode -> NMOS sink -> PMOS diode -> PMOS tail
    m0 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    m3 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, Ib, vds=0.6)
    m4 = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ib, vds=0.9)
    m5 = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, It, vds=0.3)

    # ---- error amplifier: PMOS pair (bulk = tail), NMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("p", 15, p["Lea"], It / 2, vds=0.8)
    m6 = lut.size("n", 12, p["Lld"], It / 2, vds=0.55)

    # ---- CS transconductor driving the gate diode (sized at light-load current)
    Lcs = 0.18
    Icsl = Ipl / N
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_cs"], Lcs, Icsl, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)
    n.dev("M3", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", m4)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "pb", "vin", "vin", m5)
    n.M("Ma", "tail", "pg", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wa, Lp)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vref", "tail", "tail", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "ea", "fb", "tail", "tail", m1)
    n.dev("M6", "x", "x", "vss", "vss", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "ea", "x", "vss", "vss", m6)
    n.dev("M8", "pg", "ea", "vss", "vss", m8)
    md_m = max(1, min(200, int(Wd / 20)))
    n.M("Md", "pg", "pg", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wd, Lp, m=md_m)
    mp_m = max(1, min(200, int(Wp / 20)))
    n.dev("Mp", "vout", "pg", "vin", "vin", mp, m=mp_m)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.C("Cff", "vout", "fb", p["Cff"])

    # ---------------- first-order predictions ----------------
    Gdiv = 1.0 / (R1 + R2)
    try:
        vsg_l = _vgs_for(lut, "p", Wp, Lp, Ipl, 0.6)
        vsg_h = _vgs_for(lut, "p", Wp, Lp, Iph, 0.6)
        opl = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_l, 0.6)
        oph = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_h, 0.6)
        gm_pl, gds_pl, cg_l = opl["gm"], opl["gds"], opl["cgg"]
        gm_ph, gds_ph = oph["gm"], oph["gds"]
        vgs8_h = _vgs_for(lut, "n", m8.W, Lcs, Iph / N, 0.6)
        gm8_h = lut.op("n", m8.W, Lcs, vgs8_h, 0.6)["gm"]
    except Exception:
        vsg_l, vsg_h = 0.9, mp.vgs
        gm_pl, gds_pl, cg_l = 20 * Ipl, Ipl / 5.0, 0.5 * mp.cgg
        gm_ph, gds_ph = mp.gm, mp.gds
        vgs8_h, gm8_h = m8.vgs + 0.35, 4 * Iph / N

    A = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m6.gds)
    A_h = 0.7 * A
    gm_dl, gm_dh = gm_pl / N, gm_ph / N
    r_l, r_h = m8.gm / gm_dl, gm8_h / gm_dh          # CS gm / diode gm
    k_l = beta * A * r_l * gm_pl                       # loop transconductance (S)
    k_h = beta * A_h * r_h * gm_ph
    G_l, G_h = gds_pl + Gdiv, gds_ph + Gdiv
    T0_l, T0_h = k_l / G_l, k_h / G_h
    w1k = 2 * PI * 1e3
    T1k = min(k_l / abs(complex(G_l, w1k * cl)), k_h / abs(complex(G_h, w1k * cl)))
    gbw_l = k_l / (2 * PI * cl)
    gbw_h = k_h / (2 * PI * cl)
    fg_l = gm_dl / (2 * PI * cg_l * (1 + 1.0 / N))
    fea = m1.gm / (A * 2 * PI * (m8.cgg + m1.cdd + m6.cdd + 1e-15))

    line_reg = 1.0 / min(T0_l, T0_h)
    dI = imax - imin
    dvea = max(0.0, vgs8_h - m8.vgs)
    load_reg = (dvea / A) / beta / dI + 1.0 / k_h
    off = abs(m8.vgs - m6.vgs) / A / beta
    vout_err_pct = 100 * off / vt
    iq = iref + Ib + It + Ipl / K + Ipl / N + idiv
    undershoot = dI / (2 * PI * gbw_l * cl) * 1.2
    pm_l = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw_l / fg_l) + math.atan(gbw_l / fea))

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err_pct,
        "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": db(T1k),
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "ripple_settled": 1e-3,
        "gbw_light_hz": gbw_l,
        "gbw_heavy_hz": gbw_h,
        "f_gate_light_hz": fg_l,
        "f_ea_hz": fea,
        "pm_light_deg": pm_l,
        "ea_gain_db": db(A),
        "pass_W_um": Wp,
        "vgate_heavy": vin - vsg_h,
    }
